value.rationale: The same classical truncated-octahedral graph has an intrinsic spherical 14-face flip convention and 14 natural planar 13-face conventions. Exact quantified diameter collapses (22 or 21 down to 9) and 79828 no-median triples expose a substantive, canonical boundary between these reconfiguration geometries. The all-pairs census provides a reproducible finite stress test and a nontrivial no-median witness. This is an exact motivated graph-reconfiguration classification, not an arbitrary selected small parameter or recomputation of the known 169 matching count.
